items.reason: Answer correctly lists signs of salivary gland cancer from MLP-5331: lump in ear/cheek/jaw/lip/mouth, fluid draining from ear, trouble swallowing/opening mouth, numbness/weakness/pain in face. Also accurately notes cancer may not cause symptoms and distinguishes general salivary gland symptoms from cancer-specific ones.

Answer correctly identifies diabetes and high blood pressure as the two most common causes of CKD, directly supported by MLP-5987. Also correctly notes diabetes is the most common cause of kidney failure in the US, supported by MLP-1559.

Answer correctly explains how diabetes leads to gum and teeth problems: high glucose in saliva helps harmful bacteria grow, bacteria combine with food to form plaque, some plaque causes gum disease/bad breath, other types cause tooth decay/cavities. Directly supported by MLP-4567.

Answer correctly lists common chemotherapy side effects from MLP-464: mouth sores, fatigue, nausea and vomiting, pain, hair loss. Also correctly notes these are because chemotherapy harms healthy cells, and that healthy cells recover after treatment so most side effects go away over time.
